sentences.text: Hon'Ble Sri Justice C.V. Bhaskar Reddy

This writ petition is filed to declare the action of respondent Nos.2 and 3 in not referring the Award No.Nil/2017- 18, File No.A1/1817/2017-III-patta, dated 15.07.2017 pertaining to the petitioner's house property bearing No.9-90 situated at Cheerlavancha Village, Tangalapalli Mandal, Rajanna Siricilla District under Section 64 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency and Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (for short "the Act, 2013") pursuant to the applications, dated 01.09.2017 and 09.08.2024 submitted by the petitioner as illegal and arbitrary and for other appropriate reliefs.
2. The case of the petitioner is that she is the owner and possessor of the house bearing No.9-90, to an extent of 363 square yards, situated at Cheerlavancha Village, Tangalapalli Mandal, Rajanna Siricilla District.

It is the further case of the petitioner that the said house property was acquired for the purpose of Mid-Manair Project and after following the procedure as contemplated under the provisions of Act, 2013 in File No.A1/1817/2017-III-patta, dated 15.07.2017 an award was CVBR, J Wp_27477_2024 passed and compensation was also determined.

It is the further case of the petitioner that being not satisfied with the compensation, she has submitted representations/applications dated 01.09.2017 and 09.08.2024, under Section 64 of the Act, 2013 before respondent Nos.2 and 3 seeking to enhance the compensation.
The grievance of the petitioner is that even after receiving the said representations, respondent Nos.2 and 3 are not considering the same in accordance with the provisions of the Act, 2013.

3. Considered the submissions of Sri K.Rajasekhar, learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Assistant Government Pleader for Land Acquisition appearing for the respondents and with their consent this writ petition is disposed of at the admission stage.
4. It is the specific case of the petitioner that she has submitted the representations, dated 01.09.2017 and 09.08.2024, under Section 64 of the Act, 2013 seeking enhancement of compensation, the ends of justice would be met if respondent Nos.2 and 3 are directed to examine the representations submitted by the petitioner under Section 64 of the Act, 2013 and dispose of the same in accordance with law, CVBR, J Wp_27477_2024 as expeditiously as possible, preferably,
within a period of eight (08) weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.
5.
With the above observations, this Writ Petition is disposed of.
There shall be no order as to costs.
6. As a sequel, the miscellaneous petitions pending, if any, shall stand closed.
JUSTICE C.V.BHASKAR REDDY 03.10.2024 gkv Muduganti Laxmi vs State Of Telangana on 3 October, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/68333023/
